An '''arachnoid species''' was brought into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] through the negotiations of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], just prior to the [[Battle of Mindor]]. The arachnoids were native to a minor [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]]. They were hairy and, unlike most arachnoids, had heads like those of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], including [[Mouth/Legends|mouthfuls]] of gleaming white [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], just like those of [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. During the negotiations, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] found them to be very creepy.<ref name="SM" />

==Behind the scenes==
They appear to resemble Spidrens, large predatory spider-like immortals from [[Wikipedia:Tamora Pierce|Tamora Pierce's]] [[Wikipedia:The Immortals (series)|''The Immortals'']].
